limitations: Small manually labelled development probe from two settings and three related clips, not an independent benchmark or calibrated accuracy estimate. Roof windows overlap; intent controls reuse pixels; request-mismatch controls are synthetic task changes. Labels assess only named checks and are never supplied to the model. No real beach or independently generated elevated-destination transfer clip is included.
